bundle.shortDescription: Local attention board for AI coding agents.
bundle.longDescription: AgentDeck is a local-first dashboard, tray app, and Telegram bot that tracks running AI coding agents, surfaces sessions that need a human, and lets you safely stop or mute them remotely.
